name: escanner-agent-kit
description: Gated code review for Claude Code: a closed rule vocabulary, deterministic validators and a precision filter, plus a spec-to-ship pipeline whose fix loop ends, and a reference Flutter + native agent stack.

plugins.name: review-gate
plugins.description: Rule-ID-gated code review: the finding-checker agent, rule validators, a destructive-git safety hook, project templates, and /review-gate:review.

plugins.name: dev-pipeline
plugins.description: Spec → validate → decompose → implement, checkpointed in execution_state.md, with convergence rules so the coder/reviewer loop ends.

plugins.name: flutter-native
plugins.description: Reference agents for Flutter apps with a native (C/C++) engine and iOS/Android platform code: coders, area reviewers, experts that write and review one layer, security and performance checkers.

plugins.name: device-e2e
plugins.description: Real-device e2e testing on a physical iPhone (WebDriverAgent) and Android phone (adb): the device-tester agent, its skill, and Python drivers.
